content: Hi everyone, I'm Jie from Natuvea, where we build an end-to-end encrypted messaging platform on top of libsignal. I care a lot about libsignal being correct in the actual code, not just on paper, which is what drew me to Signal Shot. My background is Rust plus a strong testing and assurance discipline, and I'm newer to Lean itself but keen to learn it here. I'd love to help on the Rust and verification side. Is there a good first task you'd point a Rust and crypto person toward?
